localization_lower_bound.entropy_contraction: For normalized psi, f=|psi|^2 and m_N=int_A_N f dmu, binary data processing gives Ent_mu(f)>=m_N log(1/delta_N)-log 2
localization_lower_bound.log_sobolev: The cutoff-uniform Gross inequality gives Ent_mu(|psi|^2)<=c_LS q0[psi] because omega>=omega0>0
localization_lower_bound.dichotomy: For large N, either q0[psi]>=log(1/delta_N)/(4c_LS)=Omega(N^2), or m_N<=1/2 and int W_N|psi|^2 dmu>=(3/2)C_N^2=Theta(N^4)
localization_lower_bound.energy_boundary: For every fixed g>0 there is c_g>0 such that E_N=inf_(||psi||=1)[q0[psi]+g int W_N|psi|^2 dmu]>=c_g N^2 for all large N
localization_lower_bound.many_chaos_scope: The entropy argument applies to every normalized vector in the nonlinear form domain and is not a finite-chaos, Krylov or trial-family estimate
